script:
[curious] So the clocks went back last night... and we all got one extra hour. Nice, right?
[sighs] But be honest. How many hours did you lose LAST week... doing the same boring jobs again and again? Replying to messages. Sending reminders. Chasing people for reviews.
[warmly] I'm Sudip, and this month I'm posting one video every day to help small business owners get more clients... and get their time back.
[confidently] So here are three jobs you can stop doing by hand.
One. When someone sends you an enquiry, they get a friendly reply straight away... even when you're busy.
Two. Every client gets a reminder the day before their appointment. Fewer no-shows.
Three. When a job's finished... a review request goes out on its own.
[excited] Set these up once, and they work for you every single day.
Follow me for the next thirty days. Tomorrow, I'm going to test your website... in three seconds.
